outline: Digital fabrication is a process to realize a design idea through the use of 3D modeling and manufacturing tools. The modularized technologies related to the digital fabrication and dynamic presentation will be introduced systematically in this course. The aim of this course is to extend the computer-aided design workflow from design thinking to digital fabrication and to prototyping.
